issues.reason: The standing half is the broken referent chain - the harvested salt-bloom and 'The salt-bloom' that came off the stones are one discourse referent that Coreference & anaphora would have share one symbol, and the parse leaves two unlinked symbols; the overstated half is that the bare kind filler is itself illicit, since 'Bob cooked dinner yesterday' -> (Patient sk_cook_1 dinner) licenses a bare constant for a bare non-count object in a dated episodic clause and the episodic-witness rule is written for bare PLURALS.

'the stones of the second pool' is a genitive of-phrase, which Possessive / genitive NP routes to PartOf (part / component) or the opaque Possession, while LocatedIn is licensed 'ONLY - in / at / inside / within' off a stated preposition, so the atom asserts a spatial containment the text never states (Core patterns: no unstated location, however obvious).

The unit half stands - 'night' is designated a day-part Time constant in the instruction set's own bound-terms list, is absent from the unit-conversion lexicon, and so cannot convert to canonical seconds or compare with any other duration, while colliding with its Time-slot sense; the magnitude half is overstated, since 'the whole night' does denote exactly one night and the instruction set derives a count from non-numeral wording elsewhere ('for days' -> MeasureAtLeast e duration 2 day).

gaps_confirmed: 'on day 33 of Year 1' - an epoch-relative day-of-year date: the Time term set has no day-of-year constructor and (Day 33) is out of range for the day-of-month reading Day otherwise carries.

'at the new-moon spring tide' - an event-noun temporal anchor under 'at': the Time value slot is specified for structured calendar terms and deictic / named constants, and the ordering machinery covers only before / after / during, so nothing licenses an event witness as a Time value.

'took the whole night' - a duration stated as a whole named period with no number and no measure-unit noun: (Measure e duration <n> <unit>) has no form for it, and unlike scale and unit there is no reserved 'unspecified' symbol for a magnitude.

A NEGATED past perfect ('The two southern pools had not bloomed', after the inspection): the anteriority rule presumes an asserted perfect event to order and says nothing about whether a Before atom is emitted for a denied one, or whether it would sit inside or outside the strength-0 bundle.

An Ordinal on an entity with no associated event and no explicit '-est' dimension ('the second pool'): the scale slot is defined as the associated event or a stated dimension, leaving only the kind symbol as a fallback.
new_gaps: A bare MASS object in a dated episodic clause that the passage later re-mentions with a definite ('harvested salt-bloom' ... 'The salt-bloom came off'): the 'bare plural in an episodic clause is a specific set' rule covers plurals only, and the 'cooked dinner' precedent licenses the bare kind filler, so nothing decides whether the first mention must mint a mass witness for the later definite to reuse - and there is no licensed way to link a kind constant to a witness after the fact. A licensed form would need to carry the identity of the participating stuff across the two clauses.

Whether an agent-nominalization head inside a compound you fused ('wooden_scraper', head 'scraper') fires the (Inheritance <nom> (can <verb>)) capability atom is undecided: Agent-nominalization says the licence is for 'a symbol you fused from the surface' and names verb+object coinages (egg_layer, dam_builder), while here the head is an ordinary dictionary nominalization in referring use ('type the referent and stop') - and the section insists 'where it fires is fixed, not a judgment call'.

'at the third watch' vs 'the second pool' show two undecided treatments of an ordinal-headed definite: one became a bare named-time constant third_watch, the other a witness plus (Ordinal sk_pool_1 2 pool), with nothing in the instruction set deciding when an ordinal NP is a named constant and when it is an entity with an Ordinal atom.
defect_summary: Issue 1: the compliant form is (PartOf sk_stones_1 sk_pool_1) - the stones are a component of the pool - or the opaque (Possession sk_stones_1 sk_pool_1) if the part test is judged to fail, never LocatedIn, which is reserved for a stated containment preposition. Issue 0 (standing half): the compliant form would be a single mass witness minted at 'harvested salt-bloom' and reused by the later definite, but the instruction set licenses no such witness for a bare mass object in an episodic clause and offers no way to link a kind constant to a witness later, so no compliant form is stated and the loss is filed as a gap. Issue 2 (standing half): no licensed form exists for 'took the whole night' - the Measure duration head requires a stated number and a measure unit, and neither is supplied - so the compliant behaviour is to leave the duration unencoded and record the gap rather than coin 'night' as a unit.
notes: The rest of the parse is strong and I found no further defects: group witnesses with per-member distribution rules for submerged / pale / southern, the singular collective 'harvest party' correctly not distributing, inspect and gather taking Theme, 'came off the stones' following the 'slid the plate off the counter' precedent rather than a phrasal verb, and the negated plural keeping both the group denial and the strength-0 member rule. The Time-value use of the tide witness and the Ordinal scale fallback are acceptable improvisation in the gap territory the reviewer correctly identified.
